title: Cash Rewards Card text message
text: ClearPath: The Cash Rewards Card is here. 0% intro APR plus 2% cash back on everything, with no annual fee. Apply in 2 min: clearpath.example/cr
notes: '0% intro APR' with no period, no go-to rate and no transaction type; no STOP or rates line. CARD-TRIGGER may also fire (an APR and a fee are stated with no purchase APR), which is acceptable.
